'''2022 MPC Jeffrey Johns DS TDIGWATT''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jeffrey Johns]] at [[2022 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jeffrey Johns]]
* '''Event:''' [[2022 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open This Deal Is Getting Worse A Johns.txt |Download]]
